title: Collision-triggered scene updates use typed entity and hitbox state
claim: Entity_CollisionProbe is a new 864-byte matching C function. It consumes mode-control flags, updates entity states and tile-grid cells, handles elapsed-tick transitions, and dispatches hitbox/tile updates through CollisionSlot and u64 mask pointers. Spawn-mask assignment is separate from its condition. Entity_UpdateHitboxWithTile is declared in entity.h using its existing typed definition; eight stale declarations are removed. Legacy wrappers still carrying pointers as words use explicit boundary conversions; their public pointer-carrier APIs remain reconstruction debt. No new pins, barriers, artificial volatile or numeric global-address views were introduced.
